sentences.text: Mark Alan Ruffalo -LRB- -LSB- ˈrʌfəloʊ -RSB- , born November 22 , 1967 -RRB- is an American actor , humanitarian , social activist and film producer .	producer	Film producer
He made his screen debut in an episode of CBS Summer Playhouse -LRB- 1989 -RRB- , followed by minor film roles .	CBS Summer Playhouse	CBS Summer Playhouse

He was part of the original cast of This Is Our Youth -LRB- 1996 -RRB- , for which he was nominated for an Independent Spirit Award .	This Is Our Youth	This Is Our Youth	Independent Spirit Award	Independent Spirit Award for Best Male Lead

Following were his roles in 13 Going on 30 -LRB- 2004 -RRB- , Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind -LRB- 2004 -RRB- , Zodiac -LRB- 2007 -RRB- , and What Does n't Kill You -LRB- 2008 -RRB- .	13 Going on 30	13 Going on 30	Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind	Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind	Zodiac	Zodiac (film)
In 2010 , he starred in the psychological thriller Shutter Island and the comedy-drama The Kids Are All Right .

For the latter , he received nominations for the SAG Award , BAFTA Award , and an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor .
